description: This Swift source file defines the class 'MenuSessionsInjector', which manages the dynamic injection and update of session and node information into an NSMenu for a macOS application. It handles cache management, menu item creation, external references, and user interactions related to session and device management through a macOS menu.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjector
classes.description: Manages injecting and updating session and node information dynamically into a macOS NSMenu for a macOS app. Handles cache updates, menu item creation, user actions, and maintains reference to external session and node data sources.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Initializes the injector with a given NSStatusItem, sets up delegate, starts cache refresh, and begins observing control channel updates.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Handles the menu opening event; refreshes cache, injects session and node data, and starts background tasks.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when menu closes, cancels ongoing tasks.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Delegate method called when menu needs refreshing; calls original delegate if any.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Provides confinement rectangle for menu placement based on original delegate.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes session snapshot cache, handles errors, and maintains cache freshness.

methods.name: refreshUsageCache
methods.description: Refreshes usage summary cache asynchronously, respecting refresh interval.

methods.name: refreshCostUsageCache
methods.description: Refreshes cost usage cache asynchronously, respecting refresh interval.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Injects session information into the provided NSMenu, building items based on current cache data.

methods.name: injectNodes
methods.description: Injects node/device information into the provided NSMenu.

methods.name: buildSubmenu
methods.description: Builds a submenu for a session row including recent messages, controls, and actions.

methods.name: buildThinkingMenu
methods.description: Builds a menu for selecting session thinking levels.

methods.name: buildVerboseMenu
methods.description: Builds a menu for toggling verbose output.

methods.name: buildPreviewSubmenu
methods.description: Builds a submenu for recent message preview.

methods.name: buildNodesOverflowMenu
methods.description: Builds a submenu for overflowing node/device entries.

methods.name: buildNodeSubmenu
methods.description: Builds a detailed node info submenu with copy and detail actions.

methods.name: makeNodeItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item for a node entry with associated actions.

methods.name: makeSessionPreviewItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item displaying a session preview with loading indicator.

methods.name: cancelPreviewTasks
methods.description: Cancels ongoing preview loading tasks.

methods.name: makeMessageItem
methods.description: Creates a non-interactive NSMenuItem containing a custom message view with icon.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Async method to refresh session cache, handles disconnection and errors.

methods.name: refreshUsageCache
methods.description: Async method to refresh usage summary cache.

methods.name: refreshCostUsageCache
methods.description: Async method to refresh cost usage summary cache.

methods.name: compactError
methods.description: Simplifies and shortens error messages for display.
